oraclePolicy.literalSource: Write literals independently from the hash-bound adopted interface and original article. Import neither production model nor its fixture into the oracle; do not turn observed DOM into expected values.
oraclePolicy.visibleEvidence: Collect text from each scoped visible node/row/metric/caveat and check its expected meaning in addition to IDs/booleans. A matching hidden title/desc, duplicate text in another panel or hidden data attribute does not satisfy it. Exact literal labels where specified; equivalent explanatory wording only through reviewed bounded alternatives, never a broad whole-page keyword match.
oraclePolicy.geometry: Collect actual visible edge endpoints/bounds and scoped node rectangles in the same coordinate system. Correspondence/branch direction must agree with SVG geometry. Zero-height horizontal SVG strokes are visible when length and painted stroke exist; do not require both width and height > 0. Bbox collision is a candidate for actual image inspection, not automatic text-overlap proof.
oraclePolicy.numbers: Only declared structural counts, phase/stage and drawing geometry are numerical. No fabricated probabilities, quality scores, curve samples, scale/time measurements, optima, causal estimates or contamination gain. Unknown semantic fields stay null/unknown.
oraclePolicy.model: Finite clamp and Math.round; nonfinite/nonnumber phase throws TypeError. Plain options only, reject unknown keys/values and malformed objects. Determinism, fresh nested output and frozen constants. Semantic fields follow rounded stage at each boundary. No new timer/network/rAF.

visibleByStage: S0: three example cards and one query feed the same model/output; inference W fixed, no weight update route.
S1: theta is latent task, distinct from W; posterior and conditional terms both feed marginalization. Display the hypothesis qualifier and no selected winner/probability values.
S2 manual: full before/after internal-representation route and limited research-setting qualifier; no optimizer/parameter update.

S3 READ: complete learning-rule route and complete five-occurrence/three-relation induction route in two readable lanes, W fixed and both limitations. Check all required path nodes/edges and visible caveats; a heading alone fails.
S4 READ: exactly three simultaneous parallel candidate paths with common prompt/output, complementary and unsettled, not mutually exclusive; no external lookup node.

visibleByStage: S0: format/label-space/input-distribution attributes distinguished from label correctness. Readable task-and-setting-dependent qualification; selector absent and both stored choices yield identical semantic/visual state.

S1: baseline/order/count rows simultaneously, exact identities/order and per-row 3/3/2 counts. Order keeps same example set; count removes trailing ex-3 only. Show shared query/W and limited label-study caveat. Do not claim removing an example holds the empirical input distribution identical.
S2: all three conditions feed the same evaluation protocol, no guaranteed improvement, optimum or recommendation to corrupt labels. Both change axes remain visible under either emphasis.
figures.selectorChecks: Six-cell stored-value × stage grid; compare scoped row text/IDs/count and actual visible emphasis. Test active choices in panel and modal, inactive stage0 absent, and retained choice on return. Other two figures' phase/options remain unchanged.

visibleByStage: S0: same model/checkpoint snapshot has separate train and heldout branches. Exactly one unknown metric inside each branch, not merely two anywhere.

S1 manual: two matching span occurrences joined by a nondirectional plain SVG path with no start/end arrowhead; separate unseen-heldout evaluation remains. Correspondence, not retrieval/causal proof or all-output memorization.

S2 READ: complete memory match strip/heldout contrast plus both qualitative panels, each with its own correct x/y labels and non-measured/non-universal caveat. Visible training-improvement-before-delayed-generalization and down/up/down shapes, no numeric axes/samples. No causal connector between phenomena.
S3 READ: train and heldout metrics remain separate, memorization is not generalization, improvement gives no guarantee. Fixed inference W must not span the training-progress timeline.

S4 READ: separate contamination schematic, two memberships inside each set with exactly one shared identity in both. Exactly three visible alternatives, cleanliness unknown and no guarantee. Actual dataset membership, contamination and score increment are unmeasured.
figures.historyFree: Fresh page READ0→2, scroll only without manual1. Full two-occurrence match strip and nondirectional relation already visible; headings/hidden hooks alone fail.

executionPlan.profile: Thirteen integer stages per six profiles. Screenshot both viewport and full scene with profile/capture labels; collect sourceResult/case/stage and PNG hash. Verify no page overflow, clipped labels or misplaced endpoints. Use reduced motion for stable captures without CSS transforms that falsify the layout.
executionPlan.semantic: Three shared callback oracles use the literals/visible assertions above, all default integers, sixty boundaries and the demonstrated selector grid. Boundary rounding tests include preceding and following labels/detail/relationship sets, not stage attribute alone.
executionPlan.keyboardModal: Home/End/arrows, previous/next, pause/replay/read return; each figure modal, focus return and namespaced IDs. Demonstrations both active choices in modal; stage0 inactive. Don't count hidden original panel as modal content.
executionPlan.read: All eleven stops forward/reverse plus two fresh-page skip paths. Wait for stable real READ stage in view, then observe scene; no forced click or semantic-state mutation. Other figure states remain independent.
executionPlan.native: One real elapsed-play case per figure; phase progresses, pause freezes, replay and completion work. Verify offscreen/manual idle with original common runtime policy; reduced-motion snapshots are not evidence of native playback.
executionPlan.noJS: Original article text/structure and all thirteen static stage descriptions readable. Controls/animation are not required. Original TODO aside and formula survive.
executionPlan.print: Assert coherent visible scene meaning separately from hidden interactive controls. Do not call a screen oracle requiring a visible selector in print. Assert original article/formula/TODO and no duplicated source content.
executionPlan.performance: Use accepted budgets (common gzip <=100 KiB, article-specific gzip <=75 KiB, CLS<=0.05, interaction<=200 ms, RAF p95<=32 ms). Measure after other browser runs stop. New lazy chunks absent on unrelated article; common pause/offscreen timer policy maintained. Separate helper observer RAF from application RAF. No measurements executed by this plan.
executionPlan.actualVisualReview: Independent reviewer views actual images for all thirteen new stages and risk-bearing options/carryovers/axes/correspondence in desktop, dark, narrow, short-PC/DSF2 and modal conditions as needed. Maintain actuallyViewed ledger; generated count never equals viewed count by assumption. Confirm readable default READ without fullscreen. Physical iPhone/screen-reader tests remain unclaimed unless executed.
